rules.title: Profanity
rules.summary: Language beyond the PG-13 tier (f/s-words, slurs; mild bar talk is fine)

rules.title: Discriminatory content
rules.summary: Racist, sexist, anti-LGBTQ+, or antisemitic content

rules.title: Player character attack
rules.summary: Attacks on a player's character, family, or personal life

rules.title: Coach / ref / official attack
rules.summary: Personal attacks on coaches, refs, or officials

rules.title: Pure personal news
rules.summary: Divorce, relationships, family — no league conduct dimension

rules.title: Fabricated statistics
rules.summary: Any cited stat must appear in source data

rules.title: Fabricated historical events
rules.summary: Past trades, picks, championships must be verifiable

rules.title: News digest personal attack
rules.summary: Same rule 3/5 standard applied to news commentary

rules.title: Voice repetition
rules.summary: Same signature phrasing as recent consecutive days (running bits exempt)

rules.title: Off-roster player
rules.summary: Implies current team membership for non-roster players

rules.title: Game coverage gap
rules.summary: A team played yesterday but the brew never mentions the game

rules.title: Cross-team misattribution
rules.summary: A story blended into another team's paragraph without naming the team

rules.title: Milestone omission
rules.summary: A must-cover milestone (trade, signing, firing) missing from the brew
